point_selection: Average day-2 log pooled RMSE ratio to Seasonal Naive over both development periods and observed/moderate weather. Require development MAPE no worse than Naive when possible. Check biased-weather robustness before locking.
ensemble_order: Evaluate individuals first, then only an equal-weight average of the top two and a fixed origin-time regime fallback of the top individual.
interval_groups: horizon day 1/2 crossed with supplied daylight flag; original seasonal-naive interval retained for the official baseline
interval_selection: Calibration-only lowest day-2 Winkler among rules with at least 95% moderate-scenario coverage; otherwise best coverage, clearly flagging failure.
test_policy: Lock model, ensemble weights, regime rule and interval rule before opening either test block; only locked winner and official Naive are scored there. No retuning from test or recent diagnostic.
rolling_interval_updates: Only completed earlier blocks enter rolling error pools; selected rule stays fixed.
success: Test RMSE at least 15% below Naive, Winkler at least 10% below Naive and >=95% coverage; show both days and every period instead of hiding failures.
